SCI-FLT-FIXED v0.1 r0.4 — FINAL FORMAL-CLOSURE
AND FREEZE-PREFLIGHT DIRECTIVE

The SCI-FLT-FIXED r0.3 architecture is accepted as the basis for the final
targeted revision.

Preserve:

- SCI-FLT-FIXED and FLT-FIXED-CONV as the sole base package/family;
- FLT-FIXED-CONV-LOWPASS only as a qualified convolution subtype;
- strict linearity with no additive term;
- one exact sampled convolution applied exactly once;
- one exact parent signal role;
- one frozen parent membership and J_full;
- A_Theta,J = J_full L_Theta;
- full-footprint-only as the sole v0.1 edge method;
- K_store as scientifically nonauthoritative;
- K_req = K_nonzero for the ordinary method;
- explicit identity and zero-operator support;
- exact MAP-observation, MAP-coadd, and JINC-observation parent roles;
- non-signal-role rejection;
- no filter/coadd commutation claim;
- transformed parent-map amplitude and inherited nominal-beam lineage;
- no automatic filtered-beam, source-amplitude, flux, or calibration claim;
- separate response families;
- covariance-authority and representation axes;
- immutable FLT-NOI-COMPATIBILITY;
- distinct bundle, parent-row, and publication policy domains;
- candidate-before-publication lifecycle;
- exposure lineage distinct from influence;
- prospective numerical-comparison policy;
- stable requirement and prediction identifiers;
- every existing nonclaim.

Do not inspect implementation, configuration, schemas, tests, audits, repairs,
validation, reductions, generated products, defaults, historical behavior, or
production status.

Do not renumber SCI-FLT-FIXED-REQ-001--051 or
SCI-FLT-FIXED-PRED-001--028. Amend existing draft wording where the same
scientific obligation is being corrected. Append identifiers only for
genuinely new obligations.

======================================================================
1. REPAIR THE CONVOLUTION SUMMATION DOMAIN
======================================================================

The current ordinary equation sums over K_geom_science while scientific
dependency and admission use K_req = K_nonzero.

For the ordinary method use exactly:

    (L_Theta m)_p
      = sum_{r in K_nonzero}
          k_Theta(r) m_{p-r}

      = sum_{r in K_req}
          k_Theta(r) m_{p-r}.

K_geom_science remains a representation-invariant geometric description, not
the arithmetic dependency set.

K_store remains serialization only.

An exact-zero coefficient:

- contributes no arithmetic term;
- requires no parent payload;
- creates no influence or covariance contribution;
- cannot cause row exclusion;
- is never classified through a floating threshold.

Do not evaluate or dereference a missing, unavailable, or non-finite parent
payload at an exact-zero coefficient.

Retain:

- identity K_req = {0};
- the exact zero operator as an explicitly supported empty arithmetic sum on
  its inherited admitted parent-support row domain.

Update the main convolution equation, operator definition, REQ-009/010/012/038,
PRED-005/009/022/023, the rationale, and the ECS.

Add a fixture in which an exact-zero geometric offset has an unavailable or
non-finite parent payload. The output row and value shall be unchanged. Turning
that coefficient into any exact nonzero value shall activate the dependency
and remove the row.

======================================================================
2. SEPARATE PLAN INDEPENDENCE FROM PARENT-FACT SELECTOR RESOLUTION
======================================================================

Replace the statement that “no parent data may select ... any selector fact”
with an exact distinction.

A. Plan and operator resolution

Parent payload amplitudes shall not select, learn, tune, or alter:

- kernel coefficients;
- cutoff or width;
- normalization;
- transfer qualification;
- edge method;
- support rule;
- thresholds;
- or another plan fact.

No amplitude-thresholded, source-sensitive, spectral-selection, or otherwise
data-derived method is admitted.

B. J_full resolution

J_full shall be resolved once from only the declared immutable parent facts:

- parent identity and row membership;
- exact parent-row admission;
- typed availability;
- typed finiteness;
- support;
- and exact required predicates.

Inspecting an authorized payload only to classify its declared finite or
non-finite state is structural screening, not convolution arithmetic and not
permission to tune the plan.

C. Reuse

Response, covariance, NOI members, and other compatible companions reuse the
same resolved J_full. They never re-resolve it from their own values.

Update Sections 2, 4, and 7, REQ-007/012/037, the rationale, and the ECS so
that the selector definition and the data-independence prohibition cannot be
read as contradictory.

======================================================================
3. DECLARE THE BASE SCALAR FIELD AND COEFFICIENT ADMISSIBILITY
======================================================================

State explicitly for SCI-FLT-FIXED v0.1:

    m, y, k_Theta(r), L_Theta, A_Theta,J are real-valued.

Every admitted sampled coefficient shall be:

- finite;
- real;
- unit-typed;
- present in one canonical exact representation;
- and content-bound before application.

A missing, non-finite, complex, unrepresentable, or conflicting coefficient
makes plan resolution unavailable. It is not repaired by the future numerical
comparison policy.

The complex quantity H(nu), where used, is a frequency-domain representation
of a real map operator. It does not authorize a complex-valued FLT signal.

Retain:

    C_out = A C_parent A^T

for this real-valued base contract.

Any future complex-valued method requires a separately named authority with
complex signal units, conjugation conventions, Hermitian covariance, and
A C A^dagger propagation.

Add real/finite-kernel requirements and fixtures for non-finite and complex
coefficient rejection.

======================================================================
4. OWNER-DISPOSITION EMPTY SCIENTIFIC OUTPUT SUPPORT
======================================================================

Define the result when a requested nonzero convolution resolves and applies but:

    S_out = empty set.

This may occur when the kernel is wider than the parent or no output row has
one complete admitted footprint.

Preferred disposition:

- record an exact applied_no_scientific_output_support state;
- preserve the plan, operator, parent, causes, and application evidence;
- make the ordinary base-signal publication action not_produced with exact
  cause no_full_footprint_output_rows;
- do not call this disabled, failed execution, zero operator, or a successful
  empty signal product.

If the owner instead authorizes a realized no-support bundle, give that state
an exact identity and specify:

- FLT-SIG availability;
- product validity;
- publication action;
- downstream admission;
- response/covariance state;
- and parent-shaped storage semantics.

Do not leave the disposition to implementation or file-writing behavior.

Identity and zero operators continue to use their explicit inherited-support
rules.

Add an empty-S_out prediction and publication-policy branch.

======================================================================
5. COMPLETE THE MARGINAL-ONLY COVARIANCE EDGE CASE
======================================================================

Retain the rule that marginal parent variances do not authorize independence.

Add:

- when an output row has exactly one nonzero parent coefficient A_ij, the
  marginal-only parent authority is sufficient for that row's conditional
  marginal:

      Var(y_i) = A_ij^2 Var(m_j);

- when a row mixes two or more parent variables, unknown cross terms make its
  exact output marginal unavailable or explicitly partial;

- the zero operator retains its separately typed zero parent-payload
  contribution;

- no one-row result authorizes cross-row covariance or independence.

Add fixtures for one-sparse, two-sparse with unknown covariance, and exact-zero
rows.

======================================================================
6. CLARIFY LATE NOI REQUESTS
======================================================================

FLT-NOI-COMPATIBILITY may record the request state known at FLT publication,
but that state is historical provenance only.

State explicitly:

- not_requested_at_FLT_publication does not prohibit a later independently
  requested SCI-NOI child;
- the later child owns its own request, applicability, eligibility,
  realization, generation, and failure;
- it still requires exact compatible FLT boundary/profile state;
- no later request or product mutates FLT;
- FLT-NOI-COMPATIBILITY never contains a future child identity.

Retain PRED-027 and add the late-request case to its fixture set.

======================================================================
7. COMPLETE SOURCE, PROFILE, AND AUTHORITY PREFLIGHT
======================================================================

Return the actual exact bytes of:

- the original seventeen-object author packet;
- AUTHOR_PACKET_MANIFEST.md;
- the r0.2 and r0.3 owner directives;
- MAP-to-FLT, JINC-to-FLT, and FLT-to-NOI boundaries;
- input_bundle_admission profile;
- input_parent_row_admission profile;
- output_publication profile;
- numerical-comparison policy;
- TRACEABILITY.json;
- BUILD_BINDING.json;
- AUTHORITY_MANIFEST.json;
- source-closure, parity, semantic-change, profile, rebuild, and visual-QA
  reports;
- all source documents and rendered PDFs.

Reproduce every quoted SHA-256.

The authority manifest shall bind every path, byte count, digest, scientific or
process role, compatibility/supersession state, and generated-view relation.

Verify the exact policy disposition for:

- S_out empty;
- base versus qualified companions;
- identity and zero;
- publication failure;
- late NOI requests.

The r0.3 profile records remain unregistered until separately owner-approved
and source-bound. No name alone creates a VAL-evaluable route.

Any unreproducible authority shall return only its dependent route or claim to
typed unavailability.

======================================================================
8. MECHANICAL AND VISUAL FREEZE PREFLIGHT
======================================================================

Verify:

- one byte-identical r0.4 normative core imported by the rationale and ECS;
- one owner-decision state;
- all source hashes reproduce;
- REQ-001--REQ-051 remain gap-free;
- any new requirement receives REQ-052 or later;
- PRED-001--PRED-028 remain gap-free;
- any new prediction receives PRED-029 or later;
- equation, requirement, prediction, route-status, and lifecycle parity;
- exact profile names and action semantics;
- no stale r0.1, r0.2, or r0.3 source identity where r0.4 is intended;
- every PDF opens and renders without clipping, overlap, broken glyphs, or
  malformed identifiers;
- title, owner, revision, date, status, and PDF metadata agree.

======================================================================
9. DELIVERABLES
======================================================================

Return:

1. revised Normative Core r0.4;
2. revised Scientist Rationale r0.4;
3. revised Engineering Conformance Specification r0.4;
4. corrected convolution equation and support crosswalk;
5. selector-resolution/data-independence amendment;
6. real finite scalar/coefficient declaration;
7. empty-output-support owner disposition;
8. marginal-only covariance edge-case amendment;
9. late-NOI-request amendment;
10. exact complete source packet;
11. AUTHORITY_MANIFEST.json;
12. requirement/equation/prediction semantic-change map;
13. owner-decision parity report;
14. core/rationale/ECS parity report;
15. PDF visual-QA and metadata report;
16. proposed conditional freeze disposition.

Do not claim implementation conformity, achieved response or covariance,
numerical adequacy, validation, calibration, observational performance,
readiness, scientific freeze, production suitability, production
authorization, or Unity activity.
